correctness.rationale: With q=1-gamma, solving the killed simple-walk resolvent gives F(q)=E[q^T]=cosh(|N-2i|theta/2)/cosh(Ntheta/2), cosh theta=1/q. Restart renewal yields M=(1-F)/(gamma F), including reset time. For y=(1-gamma)^-1=1+z, A(y)/B(y) is the Chebyshev even/half-integer numerator ratio, and sign of M-Delta (Delta=i(N-i)) is W(z)=(1+z)(A-B)-Delta z B. Both constant and linear W coefficients vanish; its z^2 coefficient is Delta/24*[N^2-5(N-2i)^2+20]. Negative value gives a beneficial infinitesimal rate. To prove global necessity, coefficients of A,B are nonnegative, with recurrence c_j/c_(j-1)=(lambda^2-(j-1+s)^2)/(j(2j-1)); when the z^2 coefficient is >=0 the ratio a_k/b_k grows by at least U/V>=3 and the positivity threshold Q_k grows by at most 14/5, so every higher W coefficient is >=0, and the top one strictly positive. Thus M>Delta for all positive rates at nonnegative threshold. At gamma->1, F->0 and M->infinity, so benefit for small gamma entails interior minimum. Even/odd N and mu=s exceptional B=1 are handled explicitly. Independent exact polynomial coefficient checks for all N<=30 and all i confirmed the predicted coefficients and sign regimes; this finite evidence does not prove the universal inequalities.

value.rationale: An exact necessary-and-sufficient global criterion is a structural improvement over known infinitesimal-reset sufficiency: in a finite absorbing chain a local no-benefit test need not generally exclude an advantageous intermediate reset rate. The theorem proves this exclusion specifically for every symmetric nearest-neighbor gambler's ruin instance, including the zero-derivative boundary, resolving a natural protocol-sensitive phase diagram and a meaningful finite-size correction.

final_claim: For symmetric simple gambler's ruin on {0,...,N}, started at i in 1..N-1, with resetting to i in lieu of a move and costing one whole step, some positive reset rate strictly reduces mean absorption time i(N-i) iff N^2-5(N-2i)^2+20<0; if >=0 every positive rate strictly worsens, including equality. The beneficial regime has an interior globally minimizing reset rate.
